lead.headline: Big Stric Energy needs a Monday miracle
lead.dek: Seven of eight lineups are final. The last one comes down to Josh Allen and Justin Jefferson against James Cook III tonight at 5:15 PM Pacific, and Big Stric Energy is down by more than 56.
lead.pull: Bad things man bad things 156.56, Big Stric Energy 100.18. Two players against one. Odds: 3.4%.
body: Here is the whole week in one sentence: Bad things man bad things leads 156.56 to 100.18, and the only thing left on the board is Buffalo at Minnesota, tonight at 5:15 PM Pacific. Big Stric Energy has Josh Allen (22.12 projected) and Justin Jefferson (17.68). Bad things has James Cook III (14.88). That’s it. That’s the matchup.

I’ve covered this franchise all season, so I’ll say what the numbers say. Allen and Jefferson project for 39.8 together. Cook projects for 14.88. The live projection is 171.44 to 139.98, and the odds give Big Stric Energy 3.4%. This isn’t a comeback. It’s a rescue mission with two helicopters and a lot of ocean.

How did it get this deep? Jordan Love did his job and then some: 36.18, the best day on the roster. Nobody followed him. Josh Jacobs, Questionable all week with a hand, played and scored 0.5 against a 15.04 projection. Tucker Kraft scored 1.9. Ashton Jeanty 7.0, Saquon Barkley 8.2. Love carried a sofa up the stairs by himself and the movers stood in the driveway.

Bad things built its lead without its best quarterback day. C.J. Stroud scored 36.36 on its bench while Malik Willis scored 4.82 in the lineup. It didn’t matter, because Matthew Golden went for 32.4 against a 14.89 projection, Bijan Robinson added 26.7, and the Chicago defense chipped in 15.0. When you can leave 36.36 on the pine and still lead by more than 56, the week was yours.

The cruel little twist tonight: Cook and Allen play for the same offense. Every Buffalo touchdown that goes through the backfield helps the leader, and the trailing team needs Allen to throw it, run it and keep it for himself. Dalton Kincaid plays in this game too, from Big Stric Energy’s bench, where he can’t help anyone.

The stakes are real. Big Stric Energy is 2-6 with 29.1% playoff odds, and a seventh loss would leave it hanging by a thread. Bad things is 6-2; hold on and it joins Poochinski and AB81 in a three-way logjam at seven wins atop the league. My call: Bad things. But I’ll be watching every Allen dropback, because a 3.4% chance is not a zero.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s margin grew overnight to 6.12
quick_hits.body: Sleeper took a point back from the Maye I touch your TDs? defense overnight: the Cleveland Browns D/ST now sits at 10.0, so the final is Poochinski 181.76, Maye I touch your TDs? 175.64. Still the week’s best score for Poochinski, still the cruelest loss of the week: 175.64 points, and a sixth loss with the third-best score of the week so far.

quick_hits.headline: The top of the table is about to jam
quick_hits.body: Poochinski won and AB81 lost, so both now have seven wins and two losses. If Bad things man bad things survives tonight, it makes three teams tied at the top. Every one of them already has playoff odds at 100%; the fight now is for seeding, and it starts next week.

quick_hits.headline: Two zeros, one winner in Santa Clara
quick_hits.body: Santa Clara’s Finest started Lamar Jackson from IR and deeboliciouskins started George Pickens while Out. Both slots finished at 0.0. The Finest won anyway, 140.04 to 117.64, on Kenneth Walker III’s 36.3 and Joe Burrow’s 29.54. deeboliciouskins got 31.5 from Ja’Marr Chase and lost by 22.4.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins’ Monday bench is loaded, and useless
quick_hits.body: DJ Moore (12.86 projected), T.J. Hockenson (10.62) and the Minnesota Vikings D/ST (6.31) all play tonight, all from the deeboliciouskins bench. Watch Moore: if he clears 22.4, the empty receiver slot officially cost a game. Anything less and it’s just a very bad look that didn’t change the result.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom won big with the wrong quarterback
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom beat AB81 178.18 to 120.56 behind Puka Nacua’s 35.0, even though Jared Goff scored 6.3 at quarterback while Bo Nix (16.68) and Michael Penix Jr. (14.48) sat. Nobody cares when you win by 57.62. AB81 will care that Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 12.1 against a 24.02 projection.

w9-m1.blurb: Bad things man bad things 156.56, Big Stric Energy 100.18. Big Stric’s two players project for 39.8; Bad things’ one projects for 14.88. Live projection 171.44 to 139.98. Bad things, 96.6%.
